title: GTA 6 pre-orders estimated at 7.71 million copies 📈
subject: gta6
description:
Did you pre-order on PS5 or Xbox? 👇

Sensor Tower's GTA 6 sales tracker, updated November 3, 2026, estimates 7.71 million pre-orders worth about $751 million: 5.74 million on PS5 and 1.97 million on Xbox Series X|S. These are third-party estimates; Rockstar has not shared sales figures. GTA 6 launches November 19, 2026.

Sources: Sensor Tower via Kotaku (Nov 4, 2026), tbreak (Nov 5, 2026), Inven Global (Nov 4, 2026)
Game images © Rockstar Games.
